promises.label: Deliver fault-tolerant quantum by 2029
promises.commitment: Deliver the first large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computer by 2029.
promises.outcomeSummary: Starling remains targeted for 2029; IBM reported DARPA validation, not delivery. IBM dates the commitment to its 2023 roadmap.

missing.what_was_said: Management said it was “on a path to demonstrate the first error-corrected quantum computer by 2028.” This adds an intermediate demonstration milestone, not a replacement for the 2029 delivery target: IBM’s technical roadmap distinguishes a 2028 Starling proof-of-concept from the 2029 large-scale system.

promises.label: 2026 revenue growth guidance
promises.commitment: Sustain constant-currency revenue growth of 5%-plus in 2026.
promises.outcomeSummary: IBM lowered 2026 constant-currency revenue growth guidance from more than 5 percent to four-to-five percent and reaffirmed that range; full-year delivery remains pending.

missing.what_was_said: Management identified the low end of the new 4%-5% revenue-growth range as its base case, reflecting the current environment. The high end assumed more typical pipeline conversion.

promises.label: 2026 free-cash-flow growth
promises.commitment: Grow free cash flow about $1 billion year-over-year in 2026.
promises.outcomeSummary: Full-year free-cash-flow growth guidance increased to more than $1 billion year-over-year. Free cash flow was $7.8 billion year-to-date; full-year delivery remained pending.

promises.label: Confluent operational synergies
promises.commitment: Realize about $500 million of Confluent operational-spend run-rate synergies by the end of 2027.
promises.outcomeSummary: The target remains pending: about $500 million of operational-spend run-rate synergies by the end of 2027. IBM reported accelerated cost-synergy actions, not quantified completion.

promises.label: 2026 productivity savings
promises.commitment: Generate an additional $1 billion of productivity savings in 2026, reaching $5.5 billion annual run-rate savings by year-end.
promises.outcomeSummary: Management reported productivity north of $5.5 billion, exceeding the year-end savings target.
